release_notes:
- Dark mode, finished: the last leftovers of the old dark theme are gone, so every screen now uses the same colours as light mode, adapted for dark.
- Notifications keep their colour in dark mode (blue for messages, amber for warnings, red for errors), and tooltips no longer show a white arrow.
- Buttons, tags and badges keep their own colours in dark mode instead of all turning grey, and the progress bars in Project summary are visible again.
- Links in dark mode are a readable blue.
- Some coloured texts were hard to read even in light mode and now meet contrast: group suggestions in Screening, the verdict boxes in Meta-analysis (Egger, trim-and-fill, p-curve), the status circles in Manuscript Reviewer, the "Delete" button on project cards and a badge in Power.
- Citation Chaser's empty results box, the PRISMA side panel and the sticky notes on Home now follow the dark theme.
